body:
Cooking gate callers previously could receive apparent success without verified execution, coverage or provenance. This change derives terminal status and exit codes from validated result trees, actual nonzero TRXs, native exits, source closure and complete producer-to-consumer binary identities. Selected unsupported producers are rejected before launch. Only `cooking-et-level-runtime` and `cooking-kitchen-loop` are adapted; their original build/full/focused coverage remains. Other gate objects and root defaults are unchanged.

Executed and Reused build outputs are checked against an independently pinned existing stage receipt, so coherent dependency omission/substitution and forged producer identities cannot pass. Valid explicit NoBuild/NoRestore, Windows path normalization and owned archive copies remain covered.

Refs #6. Draft; no automatic closing association. Owner Cooking-only scope applies; old out-of-scope worktree stays isolated, Unity and physical LAN remain outside this requirement.

Validation at implementation665068ae71100328cf6344b8d6c2a6fa74e968bd: main39 independent controls Passed/native0. Full249 controls Passed/native0 on disclosed dirty3490 plus exact source edits, with all216 prior controls retained and tested working bytes unchanged after commit; CRLF working/Git LF identities are separately recorded. Current distinct verification task_29beea8dc224/ctx_1fcdf6ecf3ae reruns full249 on committed665 then both original genuine Cooking gates. Earlier b8 genuine gate successes remain historical; they do not verify665. New-source results, new exact-SHA dot final acceptance, actual CI/head/base inspection and successful actual merged-source integration are still required before explicit Issue close/archive.

Trellis authority/evidence: `.trellis/tasks/10-06-cooking-issue6-truthful-gates/`. Original failures and all superseded attempts retained. No business, project, dependency, ET version, Unity or example adaptation in this PR.
title: [Cooking] Report truthful gate results and validate producer provenance
